title: App Shell + Today + Discover Design Remediation

notes: Consolidates Today/Discover navigation into one shared Kairo product shell without changing authentication, authorization or Opportunity domain semantics.
Moves Today toward the approved Opportunity-first attention queue and demotes explanatory/context UI through progressive disclosure.
Moves Discover away from dashboard-like summary tiles while preserving evidence, relevance and action semantics.
VS-50 is intentionally isolated from the currently active main-branch feature slice; its draft PR must synchronize with latest main and may not merge while another runtime slice owns main.
No API, database, publishing, provider, deployment or production changes are introduced.

approvals.rationale: Owner approved the Kairo UI compliance programme, instructed Go ahead, then explicitly asked to keep checking and proceed once VS-33 cleared. VS-50 is the first bounded remediation scope from Issue #94 and is isolated from the feature-slice runtime paths on main.
VS-50 changes presentation hierarchy and shared navigation implementation only; approved PRD requirements and product/DESIGN.md remain authoritative and no product policy is expanded.

Owner instructed the design programme to proceed. Implementation is authorized for App Shell + Today + Discover using UI UX Pro Max, ui-review, Superpowers, slice-planner, implementer and verifier; certification, merge, release and production gates remain separate.
Requires synchronization with latest main, deterministic evidence, UI Review PASS and explicit approval bound to the final exact candidate SHA.
Separate exact-SHA release approval is required.
Separate exact-SHA production-enable approval is required.

postRelease.expectedOutcome: Users can understand the selected Brand, identify the strongest current Opportunities and move between Today and Discover with substantially less dashboard/context clutter.
